gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-trocchi: Trocchi sets a dignified text serif, its wide-open round c and gently thinning bowls giving the page some polish, while Aaargh stamps heavy round-pen letters above it.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-trykker: Aaargh draws every line like steel cable, with no thick-thin shift at all. Trykker answers with literary, slightly tilted verticals and open counters, so paragraphs below it keep breathing.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-uchen: Round, bold, unmistakable. Aaargh has bowls whose walls never swell or taper, and Uchen sits beneath as a refined serif with mild contrast that lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-vollkorn-sc: Aaargh brings a lowercase a with no hairlines at all. Vollkorn SC follows in a serif with measured contrast and loosely spaced letters, which lets a long page unwind slowly.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-yuji-syuku: Aaargh pulls its strokes smooth like solder through a nozzle, a strong and commanding start before Yuji Syuku arrives. Its text serif reads with open spacing and mild thick and thin.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-amulya: Amulya is a plain sans with generous gaps in its curves, modern and tidy beside the headings. Over a longer stretch it stays easy and moderate in height.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-chillax: Chillax draws a relaxed monoline stroke, like spaghetti laid out in letters, against a heading with a much taller lowercase. Give the headline a bit more size than this plain sans.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-plein: Alien Encounters stretches its tall lowercase across big, open gaps, giving a technological feel that reads as otherworldly. Plein, a plain sans, then runs steady and reliable with a clear channel into each round letter.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-roundo: Otherworldly is the first impression, with Alien Encounters spacing its high letters far apart. And Roundo, a geometric sans-serif with moderate height and unclogged counters, keeps the text beneath it composed.
